# ECOmbare

ECOmbare is an environmental agency in Cyprus. Explore reforestation, tree gifting, village restoration and hands-on sustainability programs for companies and communities.

## Case studies

- [BrainRocket village restoration project](https://truepadarya.github.io/ecombare/cases/brainrocket/): How BrainRocket and ECOmbare restored a historic Cypriot village through tree planting, murals and five community art installations.
- [Dashin Foundation Groasis Waterboxx pilot](https://truepadarya.github.io/ecombare/cases/dashin/): ECOmbare and the Dashin Foundation tested Groasis Waterboxx at a wildfire-damaged site in Cyprus, comparing 100 plants with Waterboxx and 50 without.
- [Grow Love personalized tree gifting program](https://truepadarya.github.io/ecombare/cases/grow-love/): Grow Love is ECOmbare’s personalized tree gifting program for companies and individuals, with more than 300 trees planted across three villages in Cyprus.
- [Playrix reforestation project](https://truepadarya.github.io/ecombare/cases/playrix/): Explore the Playrix and ECOmbare reforestation project in Cyprus, where 320 Groasis Waterboxx units supported 640 native plants on a fire-damaged hillside.
